## Bad event

Content is deployed that was not reviewed by a non-stager reviewer, or to a target not approved, or twice under one approval, or after HALT. Read "by X" as "by an operation carrying X's authenticated identity" (credential separation is a premise, not a theorem). Trusted review additionally needs role disjointness between agents and reviewers (sc16_safe_disjoint; REVIEW-PACKET finding 7 closed, witness W4 = overlap_reviewer_is_agent).
